result.reason: The revision adds a professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, a 90-day conformance period, remedies, and a malicious-code warranty. However, it does not expressly warrant that the Interface and related software conform to documentation for either the preferred 12-month period or fallback 90-day period; “any deliverable” is too ambiguous to establish that software warranty. It also omits the required compliance-with-laws warranty, and the malicious-code protection applies only to the Interface rather than clearly covering all software and deliverables. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated commercial terms, but the duration trigger (“following performance”) and remedy formulation could be drafted more precisely.
